code.title: Code
code.description: The single-letter (or short) code printed at the left of the entry inside this Part III box, verbatim uppercase as printed (e.g. 'A', 'C', 'AC'). Identifies the row: entries in a coded box are aligned by this code at eval time, not by position. Null only if an amount prints with no code.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: [no-anchor] The dollar amount printed beside the code in this box (the printed label anchor is the box header on the parent array, e.g. '15 Credits'). JSON number exactly as printed with any thousands comma removed; a loss/negative prints in parentheses or with a leading minus and is negative; null if a code prints with no amount. Some codes (e.g. box 16 foreign-transaction country lines) carry text rather than a number — null the amount when the entry value is non-numeric.

title: Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) Partner's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.

final_k1.title: Final K-1
final_k1.description: The 'Final K-1' checkbox at the top of the form. TWO-STATE: true only if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise, including blank. Never return null.

amended_k1.title: Amended K-1
amended_k1.description: The 'Amended K-1' checkbox at the top of the form. TWO-STATE: true only if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise, including blank. Never return null.

partnership_ein.title: Partnership EIN
partnership_ein.description: Item A 'Partnership's employer identification number', verbatim including the hyphen, e.g. '26-3839121'.

partnership_name.title: Partnership name
partnership_name.description: The partnership name printed in item B 'Partnership's name, address, city, state, and ZIP code' (the name line before the address), verbatim, e.g. 'Pine Harbour Water Utilities LLC'.

partnership_address.title: Partnership address
partnership_address.description: The partnership mailing address in item B, below the name; join street and city/state/ZIP lines with ', ', e.g. 'P O BOX 447, Fruitland Park FL 34731'.

irs_center.title: IRS Center
irs_center.description: Item C 'IRS Center where partnership filed return', verbatim as printed, e.g. 'OGDEN'.

is_publicly_traded_partnership.title: Publicly traded partnership (PTP)
is_publicly_traded_partnership.description: Item D 'Check if this is a publicly traded partnership (PTP)'. TWO-STATE: true only if the box is marked; false otherwise, including blank. Never return null.

partner_id.title: Partner identifying number
partner_id.description: Item E 'Partner's identifying number' (SSN or EIN), verbatim as printed including any hyphens, e.g. '288-56-3387'.

partner_name.title: Partner name
partner_name.description: The partner name in item F 'Partner's name, address, city, state, and ZIP code' (name line), verbatim, e.g. 'ROBERT STEWART'.

partner_address.title: Partner address
partner_address.description: The partner mailing address in item F, below the name; join lines with ', ', e.g. 'P O BOX 447, Fruitland Park FL 34731'.

is_general_partner.title: General partner
is_general_partner.description: Item G partner-type pair: true if the 'General partner or LLC member-manager' box is marked, false if the 'Limited partner or other LLC member' box is marked (mutually exclusive — one field). Never return null.

is_domestic_partner.title: Domestic partner
is_domestic_partner.description: Item H partner-type pair: true if the 'Domestic partner' box is marked, false if the 'Foreign partner' box is marked (mutually exclusive — one field). Never return null.

partner_entity_type.title: Partner entity type
partner_entity_type.description: Item I 'What type of entity is this partner?', verbatim as printed, e.g. 'INDIVIDUAL', 'INDIVIDUAL PASSIVE', 'CORPORATION'; null if blank.

profit_share_beginning.title: Profit share beginning
profit_share_beginning.description: Item J 'Partner's share of profit, loss, and capital': the Beginning percentage on the 'Profit' row. JSON number of the printed percent, e.g. 33.3333; null if blank.

profit_share_ending.title: Profit share ending
profit_share_ending.description: Item J 'Partner's share of profit, loss, and capital': the Ending percentage on the 'Profit' row. JSON number of the printed percent, e.g. 33.3333; null if blank.

loss_share_beginning.title: Loss share beginning
loss_share_beginning.description: Item J 'Partner's share of profit, loss, and capital': the Beginning percentage on the 'Loss' row. JSON number of the printed percent, e.g. 33.3333; null if blank.

loss_share_ending.title: Loss share ending
loss_share_ending.description: Item J 'Partner's share of profit, loss, and capital': the Ending percentage on the 'Loss' row. JSON number of the printed percent, e.g. 33.3333; null if blank.

capital_share_beginning.title: Capital share beginning
capital_share_beginning.description: Item J 'Partner's share of profit, loss, and capital': the Beginning percentage on the 'Capital' row. JSON number of the printed percent, e.g. 33.3333; null if blank.

capital_share_ending.title: Capital share ending
capital_share_ending.description: Item J 'Partner's share of profit, loss, and capital': the Ending percentage on the 'Capital' row. JSON number of the printed percent, e.g. 33.3333; null if blank.

liability_nonrecourse.title: Nonrecourse liabilities
liability_nonrecourse.description: Item K 'Partner's share of liabilities at year end': the 'Nonrecourse' amount. JSON number; null if blank.

liability_qualified_nonrecourse_financin.title: Qualified nonrecourse financing
liability_qualified_nonrecourse_financin.description: Item K: the 'Qualified nonrecourse financing' amount. JSON number; null if blank.

liability_recourse.title: Recourse liabilities
liability_recourse.description: Item K: the 'Recourse' amount. JSON number; null if blank.

capital_beginning_account.title: Beginning capital account
capital_beginning_account.description: Item L 'Partner's capital account analysis': the 'Beginning capital account' amount. JSON number, negative in parentheses/with a minus; null if blank.

capital_contributed.title: Capital contributed during the year
capital_contributed.description: Item L: 'Capital contributed during the year'. JSON number; null if blank.

capital_current_year_increase_decrease.title: Current year increase (decrease)
capital_current_year_increase_decrease.description: Item L: 'Current year increase (decrease)'. JSON number, negative in parentheses/with a minus; null if blank.

capital_withdrawals_distributions.title: Withdrawals & distributions
capital_withdrawals_distributions.description: Item L: 'Withdrawals & distributions'. JSON number (usually printed in parentheses as a subtraction — negative); null if blank.

capital_ending_account.title: Ending capital account
capital_ending_account.description: Item L: 'Ending capital account'. JSON number, negative in parentheses/with a minus; null if blank.

capital_account_method.title: Capital account method
capital_account_method.description: Item L method checkbox group: which basis the capital account is reported on — one of 'Tax basis', 'GAAP', 'Section 704(b) book', or 'Other' (the box that is marked). Verbatim label of the marked box; null if none is marked.

contributed_built_in_gain_loss_property.title: Item M built-in gain/loss property
contributed_built_in_gain_loss_property.description: Item M 'Did the partner contribute property with a built-in gain or loss?' — true if 'Yes' is marked, false if 'No' is marked. NULLABLE EXCEPTION: item M exists only on the 2009+ revision; return null on the 2008 revision, which does not print item M at all.

box_1_ordinary_business_income.title: Box 1 ordinary business income
box_1_ordinary_business_income.description: Part III box '1 Ordinary business income (loss)': the dollar amount printed in the box. JSON number exactly as printed, comma removed; a loss prints in parentheses or with a leading minus and is negative; null if blank.

box_14_self_employment_earnings.title: Box 14 self-employment earnings
box_14_self_employment_earnings.description: Part III box '14 Self-employment earnings (loss)': an array of the code+amount entries printed in this box. This IS a coded box — code A = net earnings (loss) from self-employment, B = gross farming or fishing income, C = gross non-farm income; a filer may print several code lines (e.g. 'A -5,307.' and 'C 34,199.'). A single printed amount with no visible code letter is one entry with code null. Empty/absent -> null.
